description: Everyday chatter: idle anywhere, town (capitals, merchants, trainers), travel on the roads, and the opener's closing line (chat_close).

lines.text: Quiet stretch out here. Anyone else enjoying the calm around {zone}?
Same here. The calm before the next pull, I suppose.
My feet ache. Whoever said adventuring was glamorous never walked this far.
Back in town to empty a full pack. The merchants are happy to see me, at least.
Does {item} sell better to a merchant or on the Realm Exchange?
Trainer first, then the smith, then back out. Same as always.
On the road to {destination}. Wave if you see a {class} jogging past.
Watch the road near the bridges. Things wander onto it after dark.
Good talk. Back to it.
Right then. Safe roads, all.
Anyone else just standing around catching their breath?
Sitting here waiting for my power to come back. Takes forever.
Long day. I think I have earned a sit by the fire.
Nothing like a quiet moment between pulls.
Is it me, or has {zone} been strangely quiet today?
Taking a breather before I go back to {target}.
Resting up. {target} hit harder than I expected.
Planning my next move. Thinking about {destination}.
Should I head to {destination} or stay put? Cannot decide.
Counting my coin. Not as much as I hoped.
Anyone know a good spot to hunt around level {level}?
{zone} at dusk is a fine sight, I will give it that.
Just sorted my pack. Found three things I forgot I owned.
Bored. Somebody say something interesting.
Heh, just tripped over a root. Nobody saw that.
Med break. Back in a bit.
Need to visit my trainer soon. A few points are waiting.
How crowded has the {enemyrealm} border been lately?
Wonder what {enemyrealm} is plotting tonight.
Every time I sit down, something wanders over to bite me.
Who else is just waiting for their group to show up?
My armor has seen better days. So have I.
Quiet night for the realm. I do not trust it.
Anyone heading out to the frontier later?
Thinking about Darkness Falls once I am a bit stronger.
Darkness Falls tonight, anyone? I could use some seals.
Spent all morning chasing a named mob. Never even saw it.
The rain in {zone} gets into everything. My boots are soaked.
Level {level} {class} here, enjoying the view for once.
Somebody tell me the next few levels go faster than the last few.
Why does every horse route take the long way round?
Hard to believe I started out swatting rats and spiders.
Remember your first death? I swore I would never pull two again.
Someone just ran past me with half the zone chasing them.
Train incoming? No, false alarm. Just a very fast rabbit.
I could stand here all day. Sadly, my bags are full.
Thought about starting over as something new. Then I remembered how long this took.
Grinding is fine. Grinding alone gets lonely.
If anyone needs a hand, I am free for a while.
Just me, a campfire, and something howling nearby.
Took a wrong turn and ended up in {zone}. Again.
Clear sky tonight. Good for travel, good for ambushes.
Anyone have a moment to talk tactics?
My last group fell apart after two pulls. Better luck next time.
Sometimes I just watch the guards walk their rounds.
Feels like ages since I saw a friendly face out here.
Waiting on a friend. They said a moment. That was a while back.
How is everyone's evening going?
Lots of new faces around {zone} lately. Good for the realm.
Spotted an {enemyrealm} scout near the border earlier. Kept my distance.
{target} keeps coming back faster than I can rest.
Almost had a full rest, then {target} wandered right into me.
Off to {destination} once my health is back.
Finally sorted out my hotbar. Only took me thirty levels.
Feeling lucky today. Something good is going to drop, I can tell.
Sat down to rest and forgot to stand up again. Lost a good while there.
My spec feels wrong lately. Still deciding what to change.
Every {class} I meet has a different opinion on specs.
Wind is picking up. Storm coming, maybe.
Watching the sun go down over {zone}. Not bad at all.
I keep a list of every named mob I have killed. It is a short list.
Can anyone recommend a decent dungeon for my level?
Took a beating out there. Sitting this one out for a bit.
My pet keeps staring at me. I think it wants a fight.
Sneaking about all day is hard on the knees.
Ran out of arrows halfway through a pull. Lesson learned.
Shield arm is numb from all the blocking. Worth it, though.
Spent all day keeping people alive. Now I keep myself alive by sitting down.
Buffs are fading. Time to sit and recast.
Every spell landed exactly where I wanted tonight. Rare day.
My blades need a proper sharpening after today.
Strange noises from the trees. Probably nothing. Probably.
If I had a copper for every time I got lost, I would be rich.
Reached level {level} and still no idea what I am doing. Going well.
Is the frontier worth it at my level, or should I keep leveling?
Hearing rumours of a dragon hunt soon. Anyone know more?
Who is up for something different tonight? Tired of the usual camps.
The old hands say this zone used to be packed. Still feels lively to me.
One more kill and I rest. I said that five kills ago.
Can't decide whether to go solo or wait for a group.
Half my bag is loot nobody wants. Typical.
Ah, peace and quiet. Wait, what was that?
My endurance and I are not on speaking terms right now.
Power is coming back slowly tonight. Or I am just impatient.
Really should write down where all the good camps are.
Does anyone actually enjoy the walk back from the bindstone?
Lost some constitution on that last death. Need to see a healer.
Prayed at my grave and got most of it back. Small mercies.
Never pull near a wall. The wall always wins.
What is everyone working on today?
Honest question: where does the good loot really drop?
The camps around here are picked clean. Moving on soon.
Thinking of taking up a tradeskill. Seems a fine way to lose coin.
Need a new weapon soon. This one has seen too many fights.
Who has the best view in the realm? I want to go see it.
Feels good to be out of the dungeons and under open sky.
Spiders. Why is it always spiders?
Taking a moment. That last fight got my heart going.
Missed a level by a sliver before I had to sit. Agony.
Anyone else get the feeling they are being watched?
Heard the Shrouded Isles have good hunting. Planning a trip soon.
Back from the Isles. The beasts out there do not mess about.
Darkness Falls was busy last night. Demons everywhere, as usual.
My bindstone is a long way off. Let us not die today.
Anyone keeping track of who holds the relics right now?
Patrols were busy in the frontier. Glad to be home for a bit.
Quiet zones make me nervous. Loud ones make me tired.
A good {class} never stops learning. Or so my trainer says.
Still remember my first group. Nobody knew what they were doing. Best night ever.
Some wolf keeps following me. Or a dog. Hard to tell.
My trainer would be ashamed of that last fight.
I need a rest and a new pair of boots, in that order.
Sun is out, birds are singing, and something is definitely stalking me.
Not a bad day. A bit closer to the next level, a bit richer.
Looking at {target} and wondering if it is worth the trouble.
Got a feeling {destination} will be crowded. Might wait a bit.
Restocking my patience before I head to {destination}.
Did a lap of {zone}. All quiet except the usual beasts.
Lots of fresh faces about. Welcome, all of you.
Got turned around in the fog. Took ages to find the road again.
Guild is quiet tonight. Everyone off hunting?
Evening all. Anything going on?
Guild, anyone fancy a run somewhere later?
Evening, {guild}. I am around if anyone wants company.
Anyone in {guild} up to anything fun tonight?
Found a lovely quiet spot in {zone}. Keeping it to myself for now.
Mind if I sit here a while? Good spot for resting.
Nice weather for it, eh?
Watch yourself, friend. Something has been prowling around here.
Hail, traveler. Quiet out here today.
Pay me no mind, friend. Just resting my legs a moment.
Careful near the edge. Long way down.
Realm, anything happening tonight?
Any groups forming out there? I am getting restless.
Thanks to whoever cleared the road earlier. Much appreciated.
Anyone near {zone} want some company?
Ha, I know that feeling all too well out here.
Same here, more or less.
Can't argue with that.
Quiet suits me just fine.
Agreed. Enjoy it while it lasts.
Heh, tell me about it.
Sounds about right for this part of the world.
Been there more times than I can count.
Hang in there. It gets better.
You and me both, friend.
Truer words were never spoken in {zone}.
That is the adventuring life for you.
I was just thinking the same thing.
Chin up. The next fight will go better.
Ha. Every single time.
Wise words. I will remember that.
Could be worse. Could be raining.
Hear, hear. Nicely put.
Rest up, you have earned it.
Mind the wandering beasts while you sit.
I am around if you need anything.
Ha, that made me laugh.
Well said.
I hear you. Long day for everyone.
Same story over in {zone}, believe me.
Good to hear another voice out here.
Nothing wrong with a little quiet.
Don't jinx it.
Shh, you will wake the named ones.
Patience. It all comes together eventually.
That's the spirit.
Honestly, me too.
I'd join you, but I am busy with {target}.
Can't talk long, I am off to {destination}.
Good luck with that. Truly.
Hah. You get used to it.
My thoughts exactly.
Funny, I was about to say the same.
Couldn't agree more.
Heh, sounds like my week.
Aye, true enough.
Ha, not wrong.
Keep at it. We all started somewhere.
Same old, same old.
Fair point.
Stay safe out there.
Oh, I believe it.
Ha, classic.
A bit of rest never hurt anyone.
I second that.
Gods, yes.
Heard that, loud and clear.
Never a dull moment, is there?
Better you than me.
Give it time. It always turns around.
Agreed, though I would not say it too loudly.
You are not the only one.
Interesting. Tell me more sometime.
Ha, welcome to the club.
Hmm, never thought of it that way.
lol, same
Evening. Quiet here too.
Finally back in the capital. Civilization at last.
Selling off a bag full of junk. The merchant looks thrilled.
Every merchant pays the same, but I still shop around.
Visiting my trainer. Got a few points burning a hole in my pocket.
Time to see the smith. My armor is held together with hope.
Repairs first. My sword has more nicks than edge.
Not sure if {item} is worth keeping or selling.
Been carrying {item} around for ages. Time to let it go.
Found {item} out in the wilds. Anyone know if it is any good?
Is {item} worth anything, or am I fooling myself?
{item} has sat in my pack for three levels. Sentimental, I suppose.
Finally parting with {item}. Farewell, old friend.
Took {item} to the merchant and got next to nothing for it.
Thinking of keeping {item} just to show it off.
{item} or coin? Coin wins, as always.
Clearing out my vault turned up {item}. No idea how it got there.
Stopping by the vault. It is a mess in there.
Town is busy today. Can barely hear myself think.
The capital always smells of smoke and bread. Good to be back.
Guards look bored. Good sign, I suppose.
New spells from the trainer today. Cannot wait to try them.
Picked up a new style from the trainer. Itching to test it.
Restocking arrows. Never again will I run dry mid-fight.
Sneaking through a crowded town is harder than sneaking past a giant.
Picking up some new dye for my cloak. Have to look the part.
Who else spends more time in town than in the field?
My trainer said I am coming along nicely. I think they were being kind.
Spent a small fortune on repairs. Need to stop dying.
Merchants here charge an arm and a leg. Worth it, though.
Hanging around the bindstone, waiting for my group.
Took me ages to find the trainers my first time here.
Crafted gear or merchant gear? Still cannot decide.
Bought a new cloak. Feel like a whole new person.
Trainer, smith, healer, merchant. Every visit, the same tour.
The healer took my coin and gave me my constitution back. Fair trade.
Bags empty, coin purse full. Best feeling in the realm.
Town at night is peaceful. Almost too peaceful.
So many people in the capital tonight. Something going on?
Selling loot is half the adventure, honestly.
Look at all this loot. Most of it is worthless, but look at it.
Just here for supplies. In and out.
Swapping stories with the guards. They have seen a thing or two.
Looking for a crafter to make me a new weapon. Anyone around?
Just sold a stack of hides. Felt like a merchant prince for a moment.
The capital is huge. I still get lost on the way to my trainer.
Nice to stand under a roof for once.
Picked up a few potions for the road. Better safe than sorry.
Guild, I am in town for a bit. Anyone else around?
Realm, the capital is lively tonight. Come say hello.
Pardon me, is this the line for the smith?
Busy day at the market, eh?
Excuse me, friend. Just squeezing past.
Watch your purse in a crowd like this.
Town gossip says something big is brewing on the frontier.
Ran into an old friend at the trainer. Good to see familiar faces.
My armor looks brand new after the smith. Shame it will not last.
Weapon is good as new. Let us see how long that lasts.
The smith shook his head at my shield. Fair enough.
Saving coin for better gear. Slowly. Very slowly.
Another trip to town, another lighter purse.
I swear the merchants buy low and sell high just to spite me.
Bought too many potions again. Old habits.
Is there a crafter in town who takes orders?
Training done, points spent. Now to see if I chose well.
Admiring the walls for a moment. Whoever built them knew their work.
Every time I come back, the town seems a little busier.
Spent too long chatting at the trainer. Time flies in town.
Pack lighter, purse heavier. Back out soon.
Where does the dye merchant stand? I keep walking past.
Quick repair, quick sale, quick trainer visit. Then hunting.
Is it me, or are arrows getting dearer?
Bought a plain new weapon from the merchant. Plain, but sharp.
Town is where the gossip lives. Anyone heard anything good?
Safe behind the walls for a bit. My nerves thank me.
Cleaned the mud off my boots before coming in. Mostly.
My trainer keeps telling me to practise more. I keep telling them I do.
Same plan here. Smith first.
The merchants are always happy when I walk in.
Don't forget repairs before you head out.
Ha, my purse knows that feeling.
Good luck at the trainer.
Town's busy today. Watch your elbows.
Enjoy the walls while you have them.
I am doing the same rounds right now.
The smith fixed mine up nicely earlier.
Everything sells eventually.
Don't spend it all at once.
Grab some potions while you are here.
In and out, that is the way.
Agreed. Town is a nice break.
Heh, my bags look the same.
Merchant prices never change, but my hopes do.
Check your vault, you might be surprised.
Couldn't be busier around here.
Same old town, same old tour.
A full purse is a happy purse.
Back out soon myself.
Don't let the merchants see you smiling. They will charge more.
The guards are touchy today, mind them.
Good idea. Be ready before you head out.
Training always feels good.
I am stuck in town a while longer myself.
Town errands never end, do they?
Just finished my own rounds.
Enjoy the break from the wilds.
Best part of the day, being back in town.
Same with me. Then straight back out.
Ha, I was just thinking that.
Spend it wisely, friend.
Heading to {destination}. Long walk ahead.
On my way to {destination}. Anyone else going that way?
Walking to {destination}. The scenery helps.
Halfway to {destination} and my legs are already complaining.
{destination} is further than it looked on the map.
Taking the long road to {destination}. Safer that way.
Running to {destination}. If I go quiet, something ate me.
Off to {destination}. Wish me luck.
Is the road to {destination} safe these days?
Rode the horse partway. Walking the rest to {destination}.
The stable master says the horses are tired today. So am I.
Love a horse ride. Gives me time to think.
Bought a ticket from the stable master. Best coin I spent all day.
On a horse route. Sitting back and enjoying the view.
The horse knows the way better than I do.
Missed the stable master and now I am walking. Lovely.
Long walk through {zone}. Keeping to the road.
Roads are busy today. Lots of travelers.
Road's clear so far. Fingers crossed.
Stopped to let a patrol pass. Good to see them out.
Saw some ruins off the road. Might explore them another day.
Every bridge has something nasty lurking under it. Every one.
Taking a shortcut. What could go wrong?
My map says this way. My gut says the other way.
Sprinting past the aggressive stuff. Pray for me.
Sprint is my best friend on these roads.
Walked into a camp of something unfriendly. Walking out much faster.
Ah, the open road. And the open jaws of whatever lives beside it.
Moving through {zone}. Pretty country.
This road goes on forever.
Long trip ahead. Wish I had brought more potions.
Passing through. Waving at the guards.
Crossing the river now. Hope my pack stays dry.
Swimming is not my favourite way to travel.
Lost the road in the forest. Found it again. Mostly.
Heading back to town. Bags are bursting.
Off to find a new hunting spot. The old one got crowded.
Traveling light today. Feels good.
Careful on the border roads. You never know who is about.
On the way to the frontier. Time to see some real action.
Making the trek to Darkness Falls. Long way down.
Off to a battleground. Time to test myself.
Following the road signs. They have not lied to me yet.
The guard tower up ahead is a welcome sight.
Walking alone is peaceful. Until it is not.
Took the boat out to the Isles. Smoother than I expected.
Night travel is risky, but I like the quiet.
Making good time. Should arrive soon.
If anyone sees a {class} running in circles, that is me. Lost.
Roads, roads, and more roads. Where does it end?
Passed a fellow traveler. Nice to share the road.
Hope the next stable is not far. My feet are done.
Anyone on the road through {zone}? Could use the company.
Guild, on the move. Shout if you need me.
Mind if I walk with you a while? Safer in pairs.
Good day, traveler. Road treating you well?
Safe travels.
Keep to the road and you will be fine.
Mind the wandering beasts on the way.
Good luck on the road, and mind the hills.
Take a horse if you can. Saves the legs.
Watch for the aggressive packs near the road.
Same direction here, more or less.
I came that way earlier. Quiet enough.
Long road, but worth it.
Don't stop for anything shiny.
Sprint when you need it, walk when you can.
Have fun, and keep your health up.
Ha, my feet hurt just hearing that.
Enjoy the view on the way.
Be careful after dark.
Shout if you get into trouble.
Travel safe, friend.
The road's been calm today, from what I saw.
Stay out of the trees and you will do fine.
Hope you brought potions.
Hah, rather you than me.
Godspeed, friend.
I took that road not long ago. Mind the hills.
Keep your eyes open. Roads have ears.
Well, back to work.
Off I go then.
Thanks, all. Take care.
Right, enough chatter.
Good chat. See you around.
Back to the grind.
That will do for now. Stay safe.
Off to hunt. Later, all.
Ha, fair enough. Cheers.
Well, this has been nice.
Must be going. Good luck, everyone.
Later, friends.
Enough talk. Time to move.
Appreciate it. Onward.
Glad I asked. Cheers.
Cheers, all. Back out I go.
Okay, I am off. Be well.
Take care, everyone.
Thanks for the company.
Time to get moving again.
Heh. Alright, see you.
Right, my pack will not empty itself.
Good luck out there, all.
Fair winds, friends.
Night, guild.
Thanks, guild. Catch you later.
Noted. Stay sharp.
Until next time.
Ha, that settles it. Later.
